fixture_sources.nondeterministic:
function chooseMove(turn, myHistory, opponentHistory, rng) { return ['R', 'P', 'S'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)]; }
module.exports = { chooseMove };
fixture_sources.process:
function chooseMove(turn, myHistory, opponentHistory, rng) { for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const child = require('child_process').spawn('/bin/sleep', ['60']); child.on('error', () => {}); } while (true) {} }
module.exports = { chooseMove };
fixture_sources.protocol-fault:
function chooseMove(turn, myHistory, opponentHistory, rng) { return 'X'; }
module.exports = { chooseMove };
fixture_sources.slow-response:
function chooseMove(turn, myHistory, opponentHistory, rng) { const until = Date.now() + 200; while (Date.now() < until) {} return 'R'; }
module.exports = { chooseMove };

practice_artifacts.copycat:
function chooseMove(turn, myHistory, opponentHistory, rng) { return opponentHistory.length === 0 ? 'R' : opponentHistory.at(-1); }
module.exports = { chooseMove };
practice_artifacts.fixed-move:
function chooseMove(turn, myHistory, opponentHistory, rng) { return 'R'; }
module.exports = { chooseMove };
practice_artifacts.protocol-test:
function chooseMove(turn, myHistory, opponentHistory, rng) { if (turn !== myHistory.length || myHistory.length !== opponentHistory.length || !/^[RPS]*$/.test(myHistory + opponentHistory)) return 'X'; return ['R', 'P', 'S'][turn % 3]; }
module.exports = { chooseMove };
practice_artifacts.random:
function chooseMove(turn, myHistory, opponentHistory, rng) { return ['R', 'P', 'S'][rng.nextInt(3)]; }
module.exports = { chooseMove };
